notes: RetroArch (Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Super Nintendo, Mega Drive, Mega CD, Nintendo 64), for RetroAchievements (plan retroarch): pkgforge-dev's sharun AppImage of RetroArch 1.22.2 (glibc 2.43, its own Mesa for GL; Vulkan forced onto the image's Turnip by the appimage-sharun format). Replaces armGBA, Snes9x and ClownMDEmu, and RMG for N64 (Phase 6). HW 2026-11-09, Air X (A610): Vulkan on Turnip, PipeWire, every core loads from an OGUI card.

Cores (catalog "cores", retroforge-emu installs them with the AppImage): armgba and armn64 (Magnominus's own libretro cores, GitHub releases: gb/gbc/gba, n64), snes9x and genesis_plus_gx (libretro buildbot nightly). system_args loads the system's core with -L; system_requires stops a game whose core is missing (not-installed: download RetroArch again, which reinstalls missing cores) and a Mega CD game without a BIOS of any region (missing-file). RetroArch's Online Updater, core updater and Load Core are hidden, and the buildbot URL is empty: players do not install cores for other systems (user decision 2026-11-09). Its shader presets therefore come with it (catalog "folders", user decision 2026-11-23): libretro/slang-shaders at one commit, into ~/.config/retroarch/shaders/shaders_slang, where the updater would put them; the player's own presets beside it are kept.

N64 (armN64 1.3, user decision 2026-11-09, retested 2026-11-17): its core options keep their defaults (Fast/HLE accuracy, GL renderer, Native resolution). armN64 shares the frontend's context only when RetroArch draws with GL (GET_PREFERRED_HW_RENDER): beside Vulkan it falls back to its own GL context and reads every frame back at native size (slow, and Resolution never reaches the screen: the 2026-11-09 SM6115 result). armN64.cfg seeds a per-core override (config/armN64/armN64.cfg, auto_overrides_enable on by default) with video_driver glcore, so only N64 runs on RetroArch's GL driver: HW 2026-11-17, Air X (A610), Super Mario 64 at 2x 60 fps, no crackle. It writes armN64/cache (shader cache) into ~/bios (accepted) and armN64/ControllerPak into ~/saves/n64. RMG's saves are not migrated (user 2026-11-09): the core starts fresh <rom>.srm files in ~/saves/n64.

Seed retroarch.cfg (RetroArch rewrites the whole file on exit, so no comments; it keeps our keys, writing paths back as ~/...): Vulkan, PipeWire, the SDL2 joypad driver with our one autoconfig (retroforge-pad.cfg: InputPlumber's virtual Xbox Elite 2 pad, 045e:0b00 = 1118/2816, matched by ids; the AppImage ships no autoconfig, no assets, no core info); RGUI menu (needs no assets); system_directory = the flat ~/bios (armN64 writes its armN64/ folder there: accepted); pause_nonactive off (gamescope focus).

Window = the picture (window_size retroarch-log; launch_def, window_size module): RetroArch runs windowed at video_scale 1 and the launcher resizes its window to every picture size it logs (armN64's Resolution, H32/H40, hi-res), so it never scales the picture up itself (a picture under 430 lines only by the whole step that reaches 430: its menu and RetroAchievements pop-ups are drawn at the window's size, unreadable at 160x144); gamescope fits the window to the panel and, where it pre-rotates, the DPU plane scales a window-sized copy for free (HW 2026-11-18, Air X: a 600x446 window scans out as a 446x600 plane stretched to 1080x1452). The window keys are system_settings, not only seeds, so an existing retroarch.cfg gets them too. Shaders run at the window's size, so they look wrong in it: options.json picture_window (on by default, per emulator and per game) turns it off, and owns video_fullscreen: off, RetroArch fills the games display itself. video_max_swapchain_images 4: with 3, gamescope holding images blocked RetroArch's Vulkan acquire ~5 ms a frame, and windowed it missed 16-20 frames in 1800 against 2 with 4 (armN64, Hyrule Field, audio-paced).

system_settings: savefile_directory / savestate_directory = ~/saves/<system>, ~/states/<system> before every game, and sort_savefiles_enable / sort_savestates_enable off: on by default they put saves in a per-core subfolder (HW 2026-11-09). RetroArch writes its in-memory values back on exit, hence before every game, not only in the seed. Saves are <rom>.srm, as armGBA standalone named them.

Exit: one SIGTERM (OGUI's Exit) is RetroArch's normal quit in under a second, SRAM and config written (HW 2026-11-09); quit_press_twice only applies to the key. RetroArch's menu: Select + Start (input_menu_toggle_gamepad_combo 4); keyboard F5.

gamepad_profile guide-hotkeys.yaml: hold Guide for L1 load state, R1 save state, R2 fast-forward (held), Start quit (pressed twice) -- keyboard F1-F4 bound in the seed. RetroAchievements: hardcore off by default (D3; hardcore blocks loading states).
gui_args: RetroArch's menu, no content (Main menu > Emulators > Open).

achievements: the player's one RetroAchievements sign-in and Hardcore toggle (~/.config/retroforge/retroachievements.json, Settings > Library > RetroAchievements) written into retroarch.cfg before every start, RetroArch's quoting (plan standalone-cheevos): cheevos_enable off when signed out, cheevos_password always empty (only the token is kept). A sign-in in RetroArch's own menu is replaced at the next launch; RetroArch writing retroarch.cfg back 0644 at exit is tightened again then.
